title: arm_update_recheck: 4-hour self-rearming timer allow-listed (round 4 leftover) runs while locked and hidden
trigger: Quill signed in, app locked or window hidden for hours
effect: Every 4 h recheck_for_updates sends a GitHub release query regardless of lock state; the timer re-arms itself from inside its own task by overwriting preferences.update_recheck
fix: Drive the recheck from the update stage (UpdateState::Idle/UpToDate with a held deadline Task) and skip while refused_while_locked, or wake on a quill::wake signal

title: twofa_step_done leaves typed 2FA passwords in the masked inputs
trigger: Finish a recovery, reset or login-email step (poll-driven, no window), then stay on the Status view
effect: current/new/check password text typed for the finished step stays in memory in the InputState entities until the next goto_twofa_view; status_check_password is shown on the Status view itself
fix: Make the form values part of the TwoFaBox::Open stage (cleared by replacing the stage) instead of long-lived entities cleared by hand from some paths
